the 90-day period attaches only to Site conformance; no express warranty period is stated for the Services

elements.element: 90-day software conformance period (conformance to documentation, unqualified)
elements.evidence: "ninety (90) days" period is present but conformance is diluted to "in all material respects"
no services warranty duration appears; only "thirty (30) days of written notice" as a cure window for the remedy
"re-performance ... or repair or replacement ... a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: Preferred fails: the software/deliverable conformance period is ninety (90) days, not the required twelve (12) months — "for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's written acceptance and approval of the Site".

Preferred and fallback both fail on conformance quality: the insertion says the Site "will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation", whereas the position requires conformance to documentation without a materiality qualifier.

No warranty duration is expressed for the Services themselves (neither 90 days at preferred nor 30 days at fallback); the only 30-day reference is the cure window "within thirty (30) days of written notice", which is a different mechanic.
Fix minimally: change "ninety (90) days" to "twelve (12) months" for the Site/software, delete "in all material respects", and add an express 90-day warranty period for the Services.
Elements that are satisfied: professional and workmanlike standard, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair/replace/refund remedies.
The insertion is a concise addition to a clause that contained only mutual authority representations, so minimality and intent preservation are not in issue.
